**Ground truth for enterprise AI.**

Integrate, manage and secure AI in your enterprise — one ground truth: Claude Code at the deepest level, Codex and Grok Build alongside.

</div>

Olivares AI gives Claude and the rest of your AI what they need to work in a real organization — context, access to the right resources, managed sessions — and gives you the granular permissions and controls to run all of it across your infrastructure: what each model and agent can reach, the data they touch, the policies that bound them, the budgets they spend, and the audit evidence you can hand a regulator. It doesn't compete with Claude; it integrates with it, and adds the options professional and regulated environments need. One self-hosted binary — **30 modules**, **158 integrations**, **26 framework catalogs**, one console — on your own infrastructure, even air-gapped.

- **[Olivares AI](../../README.md)** — the product. One static Go binary with an embedded console; open core: the complete product under AGPL-3.0 — never crippled to upsell — with an Apache-2.0 connector SDK, plus a small, additive commercial Enterprise Edition (multi-IdP SSO, content firewall/DLP, threat intel, WORM retention, …) distributed separately — see [LICENSING.md](../../LICENSING.md).
- **[olivares.ai](https://olivares.ai)** — website and documentation.
- **Security:** report vulnerabilities privately per [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) — never via a public issue.
- **Commercial licensing:** `enterprise@olivares.ai` ([details](../../LICENSING.md)).

Also from Olivares.AI: **[Alma](https://alma.olivares.ai)** — a SaaS AI workspace (chat, image, video, audio and creative studios) built on a persistent, visual, manageable memory system.
